label: 1973 oil crisis
description: OPEC oil embargo sharply raises oil prices and cuts energy demand in many importing countries.

label: 1979 oil crisis
description: The Iranian Revolution disrupts oil supply and prices roughly double.

label: Fall of the USSR
description: The Soviet Union dissolves; industrial output and emissions in its successor states fall sharply.

label: China joins the WTO
description: China's entry into the World Trade Organization accelerates export-led growth and coal use.

label: Global financial crisis
description: A worldwide recession cuts industrial activity; emissions dip in 2009 before rebounding.

label: COVID-19 pandemic
description: Lockdowns cut transport and industry; global emissions fall sharply for one year.
